name: Cal.com
summary: A free booking page so people can pick a time on your calendar. Like Calendly.
gains: Free plan for individuals with unlimited event types
Connects to Google/Outlook calendars and Zoom/Meet
Open source, so you can self-host later and own your data
tradeoffs: Team features are paid on the hosted version
Self-hosting is a real project (database + email setup)
setupSteps: Go to cal.com and sign up for the free plan
Connect your Google or Outlook calendar
Create your event types (e.g. "15-min intro call")
Connect Zoom or Google Meet for automatic video links
Replace your Calendly link everywhere (bio, email signature, website)
freeTierLimits: Free for individuals; team scheduling features are paid.
commercialNote: AGPL: free to use, including for business. If you modify it and let other people use it over the internet, you must publish your changes under the same license. Some enterprise features are under a separate commercial license.
